author: DEREK MERRIN
title: To the editor: Kaptur votes against border security - NewsBreak
text:
By DEREK MERRIN ,
38 minutes ago
Marcy Kaptur voted against the Secure America Act this month. I was disappointed, but not surprised. Ms. Kaptur has a long record of casting bad votes that weaken America and promote illegal immigration.
The Secure America Act should not be controversial. It fully funds Immigration and Customs Enforcement and the U.S. Customs and Border Protection.
This pro-border security bill is vital for our national security and funds critical law enforcement. Funding had lapsed because of Ms. Kaptur and the Democrats’ fierce opposition. What was Ms. Kaptur’s reasoning to defund our agencies that protect our borders and rightly enforce our laws? She hasn’t provided one.
The real reason is this: Ms. Kaptur stands with the radical left wing within the Democratic Party that supports open borders and the flooding of illegal immigrants into our nation.
With the Secure America Act passed and signed into law, Americans can be relieved that this chapter of the immigration and border enforcement funding fight is behind us. But northwest Ohio voters should ask themselves why Ms. Kaptur, and Democrats in Congress, keep ending up on the wrong side of critical votes that protect our country, secure our elections, and defend American citizens.
I would welcome the opportunity to debate Ms. Kaptur this year. In 2024, she rejected The Blade’s hosting of the debate, which I had accepted. She needs to explain why she locks arms and votes with Bernie Sanders and AOC in Washington — putting illegal immigrants ahead of American security and economic interests.
Ms. Kaptur owes an explanation to the union workers of northwest Ohio on why she pushes for illegal immigrants to take the jobs of carpenters and roofers, while driving down the wages of the hard-working men and women in the construction industry. She needs to look into parents’ eyes who have had their child murdered or violently assaulted by criminal aliens that have been allowed to stay in America after their criminal convictions and illegally entering our country.
Northwest Ohioans deserve an answer for her votes in Washington that defy common sense and tear the American fabric of our nation apart. She will not debate, because she knows I will force her to answer for all her bad votes.
In the meantime, I encourage every voter in northwest Ohio to look closely at Ms. Kaptur’s record. The more voters study her votes, the more they will see the same pattern: on the biggest issues facing our country, Ms. Kaptur has been on the wrong side again and again.
Northwest Ohio deserves new leadership and a representative who fights for secure borders, safe neighborhoods, and the American worker.
That’s exactly what I will do as the next congressman representing northwest Ohio in Washington.
Mr. Merrin, of Monclova Township, is the Republican candidate for the 9th Congressional District seat currently held by Ms. Kaptur (D., Toledo).
